ports.name: New Castle, NH
ports.note: Piscataqua River channel ~200 m off the UNH Judd Gregg Marine Research Complex pier - ENC-verified 9.1-18.2 m (the pierside position first tried sits in a 1.8 m area, inside the DriX's floor). CURRENTS: gomofs is the right model for the Gulf of Maine. It publishes 3-HOURLY frames, which the vendored currents.py reads since 2026-10-07 (asv_core e02018d; a cubic in time between frames). The NOAA station predictions carry the stream near the stations and wherever the model has no water; the model, calibrated to them where it fits, carries it away from them.
